lookback_source.quote: Enter in Item N0350A, the number of days during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days) that insulin injections were received.

lookback_notes: 7-day look-back period, or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days, for both N0350A and N0350B. Per the general convention (p. 2-21), a 7-day observation period consists of the ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days; the item's own pages state only "7-day look-back period."

coding_levels.label: Orders for insulin — Enter Days

federal_coding_rules.rule: A sliding scale dosage schedule written to cover different dosages depending on lab values does not count as an order change simply because a different dose is administered based on the sliding scale guidelines.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If the sliding scale order is new, discontinued, or is the first sliding scale order for the resident, these days can be counted and coded.
